products.title: Handy Signature Solution Bag
products.body_html:
Our flagship maroon custom-printed paper bag crafted as the smart packaging solution for modern brands and retailers. Built with reinforced fold-over tops, durable paper handles, and crisp precision screen printing.

  • Premium high-GSM virgin kraft paper
  • Comfortable flat paper carry handles
  • Custom color matching & logo stamping
  • Ideal for boutiques, gift stores & premium retail

products.title: Premium Luxury Retail Bag
products.body_html:
Sleek matte monochrome paper bag manufactured with solid black face prints, crisp white gussets, and twisted cord handles. Engineered for premium apparel and lifestyle retail.

  • Solid coverage matte finish
  • Durable twisted cord rope handles
  • Deep side gussets for high volume capacity
  • FSC-certified eco-friendly paper

products.title: Designer White Kraft Bag
products.body_html:
Minimalist white kraft paper bag featuring precision fine-line print, black side panels with icons, and twisted loop handles. A benchmark in bespoke optical and luxury accessory packaging.

  • Bleached white virgin kraft substrate
  • Contrast high-density black print
  • Strong twisted paper loop handles
  • Ideal for eyewear, perfumes, cosmetics & jewelry

products.title: Heavy-Duty Kraft Paper Bag
products.body_html:
Rugged, heavy-weight natural brown kraft paper carrier bag with distinctive ink-splash artwork. Designed for garment stores, export houses, and high-load shopping.

  • High-burst factor natural brown kraft
  • Twisted paper handles with reinforced inner glue
  • High weight capacity (up to 7 kg)
  • 100% biodegradable and recyclable

products.title: Executive Corporate Branded Bag
products.body_html:
Executive corporate paper bag produced for corporate giveaways, luxury showrooms, and client delivery kits. Elegant, understated, and aligned with world-class branding standards.

  • Premium smooth kraft texture
  • Crisp deep green corporate typography
  • Reinforced base for document and brochure weight
  • Custom size formats available

products.title: Institutional Event Paper Bag
products.body_html:
Eco-conscious event and institutional carry bag tailored for academic institutions, seminars, convocations, and executive summits.

  • Eco-friendly biodegradable kraft paper
  • Precision emblem / logo printing
  • Sturdy handles for kit and document holding
  • Sustainable bulk production

products.title: Square Bottom Cake & Bakery Bag
products.body_html:
Engineered with an ultra-wide flat square bottom specifically designed to carry cake boxes, pastry packages, and bakery delicacies without tilting.

  • Wide flat base prevents box tipping
  • Grease-resistant and food-grade safe
  • Comfortable twisted loop paper handles
  • Ideal for patisseries, bakers & cloud kitchens

products.title: White Duplex Plain / Custom Bag
products.body_html:
Pristine white duplex board bag with rope handles. A versatile canvas for clean minimalist aesthetics, hot foil stamping, or embossed brand signatures.

  • Thick duplex board construction
  • Smooth laminated or matte texture
  • Soft cotton / polyester rope handles with eyelets
  • Premium rigid silhouette

products.title: Monochrome Boutique Shopping Bags
products.body_html:
Contemporary flat-handle boutique shopping bags in contrasting monochrome black and white. Designed for apparel flagships, cosmetics, and modern concept stores.

  • Comfortable wide flat paper tape handles
  • Crisp geometric structured shape
  • High GSM tear-resistant paper
  • Recyclable and compostable

products.title: Shawarma Box
products.body_html:
Premium food-grade greaseproof Shawarma Box packaging designed for quick-service restaurants, Mediterranean eateries, and cloud kitchens. Engineered with secure easy-lock tabs, oil-resistant coating, and vibrant custom brand printing.

  • 100% food-grade certified virgin board
  • Grease and moisture resistant inner lining
  • Easy fold & lock closure for fast packing
  • Custom full-color branding and logo printing
